_about: Digit ground truth for the OCR gate (ADR-019/ADR-020) on a SECOND document: Law 174/2025, the Criminal Procedure Code. Read off the rasterised pages BY EYE on 2026-09-19, before any engine was run on this file — an engine cannot be its own ruler. Same schema and same scorer as digit_ground_truth.json; only the pages are new.
_source: C:/Users/moham/Downloads/قانون الاجراءات الجنائية رقم 174 لسنة 2025.pdf, sha256 14bc1e99…, 137 pages, 600x750 pt, no text layer at all (0 chars, 1 image per page). Rasterised with pypdfium2 at scale 2.0 → 1200x1500.
_why_these_pages: p00 is the issuance page and the most consequential in the document: it carries the law's own number (١٧٤), and the numbers of the two laws it repeals (١٥٠ لسنة ١٩٥٠، ١٤٠ لسنة ٢٠١٤). It also carries a BARE SINGLE DIGIT — «بالقانون رقم ١ لسنة ٢٠٢٤» — which is ADR-019's recorded failure mode exactly (easyocr read ١٥ as ٥). p49 carries five article headers plus a comma-separated in-prose reference, «لأحكام المادتين ١٧٤، ١٧٥» — the shape where an engine that swallows the Arabic comma fuses two article numbers into one, and where the same number appears both as a header and as a reference, so the multiset comparison has to count it twice. p09 is the plain case: header plus one article header, with every number in its prose spelled as words («عشرة أيام», «خمسة عشر يومًا») rather than digits. Between them: page header, article header, in-prose reference, comma-separated list, and a single bare digit.
_header_note: The running header is identical on all pages: «الجريدة الرسمية — العدد ٤٥ مكرر (د) فى ١٢ نوفمبر سنة ٢٠٢٥». Keys are the 0-BASED image index, as in digit_ground_truth.json; here the printed page label is the image index + 2, not + 1, because the issue's own first page is not the law's first page.
_watermark_note: Unlike the 2020 gazette, every page of this document carries a watermark — a large faint Arabic wordmark and the state crest — overlaid on the text. No engine's score on the earlier document transfers to this one unchecked; that is part of what this file exists to measure.

critical.١٧٤: the law's own number, in the title «قانون رقم ١٧٤ لسنة ٢٠٢٥».
critical.١: a bare single digit — «بالقانون رقم ١ لسنة ٢٠٢٤». ADR-019 recorded easyocr dropping a digit from ١٥ and reading ٥; a one-digit number has no redundancy left to lose.
critical.١٥٠: «القانون رقم ١٥٠ لسنة ١٩٥٠» — one of the two laws this one repeals. A wrong digit here repeals a different law.

critical.٢٣: مادة (٢٣) — the only article header on the page, and what segmentation would key on.

critical.١٧٤: first number in «لأحكام المادتين ١٧٤، ١٧٥» — an engine that swallows the Arabic comma fuses it with the next number and invents an article.
critical.١٧٩: مادة (١٧٩) — the last article header on the page; a missed header silently merges two articles into one chunk.

_furniture_note: `furniture` was added on 2026-09-19 for Run 12's body-only scoring. It is not a new reading of the pages: the four tokens on each page are the page label plus the running header this file's `_header_note` already spells out in full. Adding the key changes no token in `tokens`, so Run 11's whole-page score reproduces unchanged; what it enables is the body count of 17 that ADR-029 records in prose.
